Package in.co.rays.bean

Class RoleBean

  • java.lang.Object
    • in.co.rays.bean.BaseBean
      • in.co.rays.bean.RoleBean
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    DropdownListBean
    public class RoleBean
extends BaseBean
    RoleBean is a JavaBean class that represents different roles in the system. It extends BaseBean and stores role details such as role name and description.

    It also defines constants for commonly used roles like ADMIN, STUDENT, COLLEGE, KIOSK, and FACULTY.

    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    Shad Khan
